title: Claude Code AEC Templates
description:
AEC work runs on repetitive paperwork and code lookups of RFIs, transmittals, meeting minutes, payment applications, egress and allowable-area checks. Claude Code AEC Templates is a catalog of ready-made Claude Code tools of skills, slash commands, agents, and workflows that do this work in plain language, right inside your editor. 70+ tools today, built specifically for North American architects, engineers, and builders.

The catalog covers the day-to-day: drafting construction-administration documents (RFIs, ASIs, CCDs, transmittals, meeting minutes, payment applications), running code checks against IBC / ADA / ASCE (egress, occupant load, allowable area, FAR, fire ratings), and explaining the dense stuff (zoning, specs, AIA contracts, load paths, stamps). Every tool follows North American conventions of Imperial units, IBC/AIA/ASHRAE codes, and real jurisdictions like NYC DOB and CA HCAI.

Anyone can install a tool with a single command. It drops straight into your ~/.claude folder and is ready after a restart. The whole library is editable from a Notion-backed site that publishes each tool's page and install command automatically, so the catalog keeps growing without manual packaging.

Link: https://claude-code-architecture-templates.vercel.app
